text.en: Pet owners rave about the gentle handling of nervous, sassy, or easily frightened dogs at this Bensonhurst salon. Stylists take time to comfort timid pets with belly rubs and patience, allowing first-time rescue dogs to complete appointments happily without distress.

Reviewers consistently applaud the grooming finish, noting that dogs return home looking adorable, smelling clean, and trimmed exactly to owner specifications. Clients praise the precision of coat trims on chihuahuas, poodle mixes, and varied toy breeds.

Clients describe groomers such as Angie and Deirdre as exceptionally warm, skilled, and dedicated. Pet parents appreciate that staff send reassuring photos and updates during grooming sessions, helping anxious owners feel completely relaxed throughout the visit.

q.en: Is the salon suitable for dogs that get anxious during grooming?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently note that stylists specialize in calming nervous dogs with gentle handling and patience.

q.en: Do groomers send updates to owners during the visit?

a.en: Reviewers appreciate receiving pictures and progress messages while their pets are being groomed.

q.en: Can I book specific cuts for small or mixed breeds?

a.en: Clients report that groomers tailor trims precisely to customer preferences for various small dog breeds.
